# KayKit Character Animations 1.2

- Creator: Kay Lousberg / KayKit
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 (CC0-1.0)
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/kaykit-character-animations
- Source archive SHA-256: `C9D3FBEA492DC6EDD0903939369A564C2240B892430BCD99E0AEE4876110BB8F`

The glTF animation bundle is retained as an evaluated CC0 source asset. Its
legacy six-bone `Roll` clip is not used by the current Knight because that clip
cannot faithfully drive the Knight's full humanoid skeleton. Run
`tools/assets/setup_external_assets.ps1` to recreate the complete ignored source
package in `asset_staging/`.
